cp29:1.1: Saccasa' vhayapaṇḍitacariyaṃ aṭṭhamaṃ Punāparaṃ yadā homi Magadhe vaṭṭapotako ajātapakkho taruṇo maṃsapesi kulāvake, || ||
cp29:2.1: Mukhatuṇḍakenāharitvā mātā posayatī mamaṃ tassā phassena jīvāmi natthi me kāyikaṃ balaṃ. || ||
cp29:3.1: Saṃvacchare gimhasamaye davaḍāho padippati upagacchati amhākaṃ pāvako kaṇhavattani. || ||
cp29:4.1: Dhāmadhāmañ janitv' evaṃ saddāyanto mahāsikhī anupubbena jhāpento aggi mamam-upāgami. || ||
cp29:5.1: Āggivegabhayā bhītā tasitā mātā pitā mama kulāvake maṃ chaḍḍetvā attānaṃ parimocayuṃ. || ||
cp29:6.1: Pāde pakkhe pajahāmi natthi me kāyikaṃ balaṃ so' haṃ agatiko tattha evaṃ cintes' ahaṃ tadā. || ||
cp29:7.1: Yes' āhaṃ upadhāveyyaṃ bhīto tasitavedhito te maṃ ohāya pakkantā kathaṃ me ajja kātave. || ||
cp29:8.1: Atthi loke sīlaguṇo saccaṃ soceyya' nuddayā tena saccena kāhāmi saccakiriyam-uttamaṃ. || ||
cp29:9.1: Āvajjetvā dhammabalaṃ saritvā pubbake jine saccabalam-avassāya saccakiriyam-akās' ahaṃ. || ||
cp29:10.1: Santi pakkhā patanā santi pādā avañcanā mātā pitā ca nikkhantā jātaveda paṭikkama. || ||
cp29:11.1: Saha sacce kate mayhaṃ mahāpajjalito sikhī vajjesi soḷasakarīsāni udakaṃ patvā yathā sikhī; saccena me samo natthi esā me saccapāramīti. || ||
